Reducto Office for legal

# Your agent redlines. You revise.

Reducto Office opens the contract in a live .docx editor that ChatGPT, Claude or any MCP client can edit. Every change is a tracked change with a comment, so you review it like any other markup.

## Ask the way you would ask an associate

- Redline this MSA against our playbook.
- Make the indemnity mutual and cap it at 2x fees.
- Add a data protection clause after clause 9.
- Comment on every auto-renewal and notice period.
- Accept the formatting changes. Leave the rest for me.
- Draft a one-page mutual NDA in our house style.

## Open the redline. It is a real .docx file.

Tracked changes and comments are standard .docx revisions, so the same file opens with the same markup in .docx.

Loading editor…

## Built for contract work

Tracked changesInsertions, deletions and formatting changes, by author. Accept or reject one at a time or all at once.

CommentsComments anchored to the exact words they are about.

Numbering and fieldsNumbered clauses, cross-references, headers, footers, footnotes and endnotes.

TablesInsert rows and columns, edit cells and merge them.

Faithful pagesPages render to closely match how they look in .docx.

Live togetherYou and your agent in one document, with shared cursors and edits as they happen.

1. 1

   Connect your agent

   In ChatGPT, open Settings, then Apps, find Reducto Office and click Connect. In Claude or another MCP client, add a remote MCP server at `https://office.reducto.ai/mcp/app`.
2. 2

   Sign in

   Sign in with your Reducto account.
3. 3

   Bring a file

   Upload a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx, or ask your agent to start one. The editor opens with the file, and you can work in it too.
